new_commodity_proposals.term: Frozen Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Bites
new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Frozen, fully cooked, breaded white-meat chicken in 1.5-3 lb bags (Just Bare, Tyson, Kirkland) at roughly $6-9/lb - three to four times raw breast per lb, and part of the weight is breading. The pre-resolver found no vocabulary row sharing a core word and its board sweep for this term returned only chicken-breast, which is the standing fresh/frozen form-flip rejection. If an id already prices frozen breaded chicken (e.g. a nugget or tender id under another spelling), alias to it rather than minting.

Soft mozzarella packed in water, sold in 8 oz tubs/logs at roughly twice low-moisture mozzarella per oz, with a different moisture basis; the existing mozzarella-cheese, reduced-fat-mozzarella and burrata rows are all different products. The pre-resolver reports no commodity claims it although today's captures carry matching products, and a 2026-08-26 ruling already used this id.
